description: US-listed bitcoin-treasury perpetual preferreds (Strategy STRF, STRC, STRK, STRD; Strive SATA, SATS) ranked by effective yield (annual dividend ÷ price) on the latest delayed print. Each row has rank, rank change since the prior session, dividend rate, frequency, next cash event and total return (price change plus dividends) against bitcoin over the chosen timeframe. Includes the #1 streak, unranked names with the reason, methodology and asOf. A sort, not a recommendation.

timeframe.description: Window for the total-return comparison with bitcoin. Default 3M.
